guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails during the RUN command that attempts to run 'update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3 1 && update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/pip3 pip3 /usr/bin/pip3 1'. The error is: "update-alternatives: <link> and <path> can't be the same". This happens because the command tries to link /usr/bin/python3 to /usr/bin/python3 itself, which is invalid. To fix this, remove or correct the update-alternatives lines related to python3 and pip3 since the base Ubuntu 22.04 image already provides python3 and pip3 correctly. Instead, verify the actual python3 and pip3 binary paths and use update-alternatives only if you want to set symlinks to specific alternative versions, otherwise skip these commands. This fix will allow the Dockerfile to build properly and set up the environment for testing.
